policy.description: FENGARDE retention: generated incident/NIS2 reports, delete 365 days after index creation. Design-A (2026-07-29 audit): reports-* previously had NO ISM policy at all (self-disclosed gap -- a NIS2/compliance report citing an alert could sit on an index with undefined retention behavior, worse than merely 'short'). Matches ism-alerts-365d.json's lifetime since a report is only as substantiable as the alert(s) it cites -- retaining the report for less time than the alert it was generated from would recreate the exact evidentiary gap this policy exists to close. Age-based only (daily date-suffixed indices, no write alias -- see ism-events-common-90d.json). ism_template auto-attaches this policy to matching indices at creation time.
